operation.description: search: one page of flow_type's runs, newest first; for the next page, filter startTime lt the oldest start_time shown. summary, state, history: one run of flow_id. logs: the end of the Live application container's log.

flow_type.description: search only: a Flow type of the deployed application.

flow_id.description: summary, state and history: the FlowID of an application run.

filters.description: search only: conditions on flowId, executionStatus, startTime, closeTime or an indexed Attribute key of flow_type.

values.description: Values as text; numbers and booleans are written as text too.

after_event_id.description: history only: return events after this event ID; use next_after_event_id of the previous page.

page_size.description: search and history: the most runs or events to return.

tail_lines.description: logs only: the most log lines to return.
